Initial release of IRIS ObjectScript code formatter and style checker (free version):

- Provides formatting, compliance checking, and correction for InterSystems IRIS ObjectScript code, including variable/method naming, locking, transactions, formatting, spacing, and comments.
- Includes quick reference tables and fix templates for personal/individual use.
- Supports core operations via input parameters and runtime configuration via config options.
- Offers detailed code review reports and error explanations for non-compliant code.
- Includes best practice guides, common issue Q&As, and clear usage scenarios.
- Requires LLM-based agent with tool-use capability; no extra API key needed; works on Windows, macOS, or Linux with recommended IRIS versions.
